entities.name: Heinrich Grünfeld
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heinrich Grünfeld was a Czech-Austrian cellist, music educator and composer. He published his autobiography, 'In Dur und Moll' in 1923, an historically important source for Brahms, Joachim, and Richard Strauss. He is the brother of pianist and composer Alfred Grünfeld.
